items.prompt: Write 2-3 sentences about whether you think it is better to have PE class or art class. Include your opinion, TWO reasons, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: I think PE class is better than art class because it keeps our bodies strong and healthy. Also, running and playing games helps us feel less stressed. That is why PE class should be every day.

items.prompt:
Read this opinion paragraph and identify what is strong and what could be improved:

'I think we should have a school garden. Gardens are green. I like gardens. That is all.'
items.answer: The opinion ('we should have a school garden') is clear. However, the reasons ('gardens are green' and 'I like gardens') are weak because they do not explain a real benefit. The closing ('That is all') does not wrap up well. Better reasons: gardens teach us about nature and help us grow healthy food.

steps: Strong: the opinion is stated clearly.
Weak: the reasons do not explain why a school garden benefits students.
Weak: 'That is all' is not a real closing sentence.
Better closing: 'That is why every school should have a garden.'

items.prompt: Your teacher gave you this topic: 'Should students be allowed to bring toys to school?' Write a full 3-sentence opinion paragraph: opinion, two reasons, and a closing.
items.answer: I think students should not be allowed to bring toys to school because toys can distract students from learning. Also, someone might lose their toy and feel sad. That is why it is better to leave toys at home.

steps: Sentence 1: 'I think students should/should not bring toys to school because...'

items.prompt:
Rewrite this weak opinion paragraph to make it stronger. Add specific reasons and a better closing.

'I think dogs are nice. They are animals. Dogs are good.'
items.answer: I think dogs are wonderful pets because they are loyal and always happy to see you. Dogs also help you stay active by going on walks every day. That is why I believe dogs make the best pets.

steps: Replace 'nice' with a more specific opinion.
Replace 'they are animals' with a real reason about what dogs do.
Replace 'Dogs are good' with a proper closing sentence.

items.prompt: A classmate argues: 'I think homework is good because it helps you practice.' You disagree. Write 2-3 sentences expressing your opposing opinion with two reasons.
items.answer: I think homework is not helpful because students are tired after a long school day and need time to rest. Also, families do not always have time to help with homework, which can cause stress. That is why I believe learning should happen at school, not at home.

steps: Start with 'I think homework is not helpful because...'

items.prompt: Write an opinion paragraph about your favorite book genre (like funny books, adventure books, or animal books). Include your opinion, two reasons, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: I think adventure books are the best kind of books because they take you to exciting new places in your imagination. Also, adventure stories always have problems to solve, which makes them fun to read. That is why adventure books are my favorite.

items.prompt:
A student wrote: 'I believe school lunches should be healthier because then kids would not be hungry and they could learn better and also they would grow up strong and big.'

This is one long sentence. Break it into a 3-sentence opinion paragraph.
items.answer: I believe school lunches should be healthier because kids need good food to stay focused and learn better. Healthy lunches also help children grow up strong. That is why improving school lunches would help every student.

items.prompt: Think about this question: 'Is it better to live in a big city or a small town?' Write a 3-sentence opinion paragraph from your point of view.
items.answer: I think it is better to live in a small town because it is quiet and safe, and you can know all your neighbors. Also, small towns have parks and open spaces where you can play outside every day. That is why a small town would be a wonderful place to grow up.

items.prompt:
Evaluate this opinion paragraph. Does it have all the required parts? Fix any missing parts.

'I think students should learn about animals. Animals are interesting.'
items.answer: The paragraph has an opinion and one reason but is missing a second reason and a closing. Fixed version: 'I think students should learn about animals because animals are interesting and help us understand nature. Knowing about animals also teaches us to be kind to all living things. That is why animal lessons should be part of every class.'

steps: Check: opinion (yes), reason (yes, one), second reason (missing), closing (missing).

items.prompt: Write an opinion paragraph about whether it is better to spend free time indoors or outdoors. Aim for 3 complete sentences with an opinion, two reasons, and a closing.
items.answer: I think spending free time outdoors is better because the sunshine and fresh air make you feel happy and healthy. Outdoor play also helps you use your imagination and make new friends. That is why going outside is the best way to spend your free time.

items.prompt:
Your teacher says good opinion writing uses specific details, not just 'I like it' or 'it is good.' Revise this sentence to use specific details:

'I think music class is good because it is nice.'
items.answer: I think music class is important because learning to sing and play instruments helps students express their feelings and builds memory skills.

steps: Replace 'good' with a stronger word like 'important' or 'wonderful.'
Replace 'it is nice' with a specific benefit: what does music class actually do for students?

items.prompt: Write a 3-sentence opinion about whether students should choose their own seats in class or be assigned seats. Include opinion, two reasons, and a closing.
items.answer: I think students should be assigned seats because it helps them stay focused and not always sit with the same friends. Assigned seats also make sure everyone gets a fair spot where they can see the board. That is why teachers should choose seats for their students.

items.prompt:
Compare these two closing sentences. Which is better and why?

A) That is the end.
B) That is why I believe every student should have a chance to play a sport.
items.answer: B is better because it restates the writer's opinion and gives a sense of finality. Sentence A just announces the end without connecting back to the topic.

steps: A good closing links back to the opinion.
Sentence B restates the opinion ('every student should have a chance to play a sport').
Sentence A does not remind the reader what the paragraph was about.

items.prompt: You read a book about penguins. Now your teacher asks you to write your opinion about whether penguins are interesting animals. Write a full 3-sentence opinion paragraph.
items.answer: I think penguins are very interesting animals because they live in one of the coldest places on Earth and they cannot fly even though they are birds. Also, penguins take care of their babies in a special way by keeping their eggs warm on their feet. That is why I believe penguins are one of the most fascinating animals in the world.

steps: Sentence 1: opinion + first reason about penguins.
Sentence 2: a second interesting fact as a reason.

items.prompt:
A student wrote a good opinion paragraph but left out the reason. Add a reason to make the paragraph complete:

'I think every child should learn to ride a bike. _____. That is why bike riding is an important skill to learn.'
items.answer: I think every child should learn to ride a bike. Riding a bike is a great way to get exercise and explore your neighborhood without needing a car. That is why bike riding is an important skill to learn.

steps: The blank needs a reason that supports the opinion 'every child should learn to ride a bike.'
A good reason explains a benefit: exercise, independence, or fun.
